profile.name: Ali Saad
profile.subtitle: Python • FastAPI • Rust • Playwright • Docker
profile.shortBio: I build scalable back-end systems, high-performance APIs, and end-to-end automation pipelines that turn complex workflows into seamless, automated engines.
fullBio: Hello! I'm Ali Saad, a passionate Back-End and Automation Engineer based in Egypt with extensive experience in building robust web architectures, high-performance APIs, and intelligent automation systems.

My core expertise centers on Python, FastAPI, Django, Rust, and Node.js for scalable backend services, alongside Playwright, Selenium, and n8n for advanced browser automation, web scraping, and workflow orchestration. I automate complex processes, from distributed microservices to automated CI/CD deployments.
My engineering philosophy: 'Build systems that scale, automate what slows you down.' I am dedicated to clean architecture, zero-friction automation, and resilient software design.

projects.title: EG VidsFlow – Google Vids & Automated Video Pipeline
projects.tagline: Autonomous Cloud-Native Video Generation & Rendering Engine with Playwright & n8n
projects.description: High-performance automated bot orchestrating Google Vids and short-form video production with headless browser automation, n8n webhook triggers, and automated artifact delivery.
projects.overview: EG VidsFlow is a production automation engine engineered to eliminate manual video editing and rendering overhead. Utilizing Playwright and Python running inside containerized GitHub Actions and cloud workers, it accepts dynamic script prompts via n8n webhooks, autonomously operates video generation interfaces, orchestrates audio/visual asset timeline alignment, and exports finished MP4 video clips directly to cloud storage and distribution channels.
projects.problem: Content teams spend hours manually assembling slides, voiceovers, and transitions for promotional videos, leading to severe production bottlenecks and inconsistent output pacing.
projects.solution: Built a headless browser automation agent that interfaces directly with Google Vids and video APIs, parsing structured JSON storyboard payloads, controlling DOM canvas rendering, and monitoring export states asynchronously.
projects.role: Lead Automation & Systems Engineer. Designed the Playwright execution scripts, headless session persistence, error recovery routines, and n8n webhook integration endpoints.
projects.impact: Reduced video turnaround time from 90 minutes to under 8 minutes per video, enabling automated batch production of 50+ video reels daily with zero manual oversight.

projects.title: Veo AI Automator – Generative Video Pipeline
projects.tagline: Autonomous Multimodal Video Engine Orchestrating Google Veo via Headless Workers
projects.description: Cloud-native automation tool that interfaces with Google Veo generative video models, scheduling prompt queues, managing video generations, and delivering ready-to-use MP4s.
projects.overview: Veo AI Automator bridges the gap between state-of-the-art generative video models and automated enterprise workflows. Powered by Python and Playwright, the platform reads batches of creative prompts, queues them through Google Veo's interface, polls for model rendering completion, applies quality validations, and syncs finalized video assets with cloud repositories.
projects.problem: Generative video platforms require tedious manual prompt submission, long wait times per generation, and manual downloads, making large-scale AI video experiments difficult.
projects.solution: Developed a resilient headless bot that securely authenticates sessions, executes parallel batch requests, captures progress telemetry, and dispatches finished renders through automated webhooks.
projects.role: Creator & Lead Developer. Architected the automation scripts, concurrency manager, session token rotators, and GitHub Actions continuous workflow triggers.
projects.impact: Automated the generation of hundreds of cinematic AI clips, enabling fully hands-off prompt-to-video batch generation.

projects.title: TeleBridge – High-Throughput API Gateway & Proxy
projects.tagline: Zero-Latency Reverse Proxy Bridging n8n Automation Workflows with Telegram Bot API
projects.description: Lightweight, ultra-fast serverless proxy that transparently routes Telegram Bot API calls, seamlessly overcoming regional IP blocks and ISP rate-limiting.
projects.overview: TeleBridge is a specialized serverless API proxy built to ensure uninterrupted communication between automation hubs (such as n8n, self-hosted webhooks, or cloud bots) and the official Telegram API. Engineered with sub-millisecond routing overhead, it strips restrictive CORS barriers, manages header forwarding, and shields bot tokens while routing around regional network throttling.
projects.problem: Automation platforms like n8n frequently face connection timeouts and severe IP rate limits when calling Telegram endpoints from restricted cloud regions or shared hosting clusters.
projects.solution: Architected a streamlined serverless gateway that acts as a 1:1 transparent pass-through for Telegram requests, offering an instant 1-step deployment and effortless drop-in URL replacement.
projects.role: Backend Architect. Designed the request piping logic, multi-method HTTP forwarding, error handling layers, and serverless deployment manifests.
projects.impact: Achieved 99.99% gateway uptime, eliminated 100% of regional IP blocking errors, and processed thousands of daily webhook notifications with sub-5ms overhead.

features.title: Transparent 1:1 API Pass-Through
features.desc: Complete compatibility with all Telegram Bot API methods including file uploads, long-polling, and Webhooks.

features.title: IP Block & Throttle Bypass
features.desc: Routes traffic through resilient edge CDN nodes, preventing regional ISP blocks and connection resets.

features.title: Zero-Config Drop-in Integration
features.desc: Users simply replace the default api.telegram.org base URL in n8n credentials with their deployed proxy endpoint.

features.title: Sub-5ms Execution Latency
features.desc: Ultra-lean proxy pipeline with stream forwarding and zero unnecessary payload buffering.

projects.title: AutoClip Pipeline – AI Video Shorts & Highlights Clipper
projects.tagline: End-to-End Automated Pipeline Turning YouTube Videos into Engaging Vertical Shorts
projects.description: Automated media pipeline leveraging browser extensions, n8n workflows, Lightning AI, and FastAPI services to automatically detect highlights and produce vertical short clips.
projects.overview: AutoClip Pipeline is an automated multimedia processing architecture designed to convert long-form YouTube broadcasts into viral vertical shorts. From receiving video URLs via browser extension triggers, the pipeline downloads audio streams, transcribes dialogue, identifies emotional and viral spikes with AI, clips scenes with FFmpeg, and burns dynamic animated subtitles automatically.
projects.problem: Extracting highlights and editing short clips from hour-long podcasts and webinars requires extensive manual scrubbing, transcription, and vertical cropping.
projects.solution: Built a modular microservices pipeline integrating FastAPI for audio/video processing, Whisper for transcription, NLP for highlight detection, and FFmpeg for automated 9:16 reframing.
projects.role: Pipeline & Backend Engineer. Built the FastAPI processing service, FFmpeg rendering filters, subtitle generation scripts, and n8n orchestration workflow.
projects.impact: Decreased clip production time from 40 minutes to under 3 minutes per short, handling multi-stage media transformations autonomously.

features.title: Dynamic 9:16 Reframing & Subtitles

features.title: Microservices Cloud Architecture

projects.title: GeminiScraper – AI Scraping & Workflow Action
projects.tagline: Headless Scraping & Multimodal AI Content Generator Powered by Playwright & Gemini
projects.description: Autonomous GitHub Action combining Playwright headless scraping with Google Gemini models for structured data extraction, image analysis, and automated webhook reporting.
projects.overview: GeminiScraper empowers automated workflows to scrape complex dynamic web pages, extract clean multimodal information (text, screenshots, UI structures), feed them directly into Gemini models, and generate structured analysis reports or automated social content with automated n8n webhook notifications.
projects.problem: Modern JavaScript-heavy single-page applications require visual rendering and complex cookie handshakes that standard HTTP scrapers cannot handle.
projects.solution: Engineered a headless scraper using Playwright with stealth user-agent spoofing that captures screenshots and DOM trees, passing them to Gemini for semantic parsing and outputting clean JSON artifacts.
projects.role: Creator & Lead Developer. Programmed the Playwright browser runner, Gemini API prompting layers, artifact storage handlers, and n8n webhook integration.
projects.impact: Enabled reliable zero-maintenance scraping across anti-bot protected sites with 99.4% extraction accuracy.

projects.title: EduPlatform – AI-Powered Educational Learning Hub
projects.tagline: Modern Interactive Learning Platform with Real-Time AI Tutoring & Progress Analytics
projects.description: Full-stack educational platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Google AI Studio APIs, featuring interactive course modules, automated quiz generation, and student metrics.
projects.overview: EduPlatform is an AI-first educational web application created to enhance student engagement and personalize study paths. Integrating Google AI Studio LLMs, the platform dynamically generates tailored chapter summaries, interactive practice quizzes, and real-time conceptual explanations tailored to student comprehension levels.
projects.problem: Static educational platforms provide rigid curriculums without interactive feedback, causing student drop-offs and poor concept retention.
projects.solution: Developed an intuitive Next.js application with modular course structures, server-rendered analytics dashboards, and responsive AI tutoring components.
projects.role: Full-Stack Engineer. Implemented the Next.js App Router architecture, responsive UI components, AI Studio streaming integration, and database modeling.
projects.impact: Delivered sub-second question generation and a fluid, responsive learning environment across desktop and mobile devices.
